description: Solar Forecast Arbiter Core is the project's Python package for gathering, checking and evaluating solar observations and forecasts. It contains site and photovoltaic-plant data models, reference forecast methods, quality filters, forecast metrics and report generation. Inputs pair forecasts with observations and specify sites, variables and evaluation periods; outputs include quality flags, metric results and plots. Geographic coverage, time resolution and forecast horizon follow the supplied series. MIT source is free through GitHub. A limitation is that the separate dashboard and API are not included in this core repository, and data quality or mismatched time intervals can affect comparisons. The package can help validate photovoltaic-generation inputs used in electricity simulations. PVNet (model-pvnet) provides a related forecasting model. The API documentation was inspected, but no account, forecast submission or provider data connection was used.
